items.title: Live: Messi breaks World Cup goal scoring record after dramatic penalty miss
items.description: Lionel Messi has become the top scorer in Men's World Cup history with a stunning strike against Austria, but only after the 38-year-old fluffs his lines from the penalty spot. Follow live.

items.title: Iran to allow nuclear inspections, JD Vance says
items.description: The US vice president says that progress has been made in talks with Iran, with Tehran agreeing to allow nuclear inspectors and a mechanism to keep the Strait of Hormuz open.

items.title: Australian trust in China grows as belief in US hits record low
items.description: The Lowy Institute's latest poll shows Australia's trust in the US has fallen to a record low.

items.title: Sir Keir Starmer's landslide win left him with shaky foundations
items.description: The former prosecutor who styled himself as a safe, even boring, pair of hands became the first Labour PM in 14 years to win in a landslide. It was not enough to keep him in the job.

items.title: Starmer resigns as PM with Andy Burnham poised to get top job
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer will resign as prime minister of the UK, succumbing to intense pressure within his own Labour party less than two years after winning one of its biggest ever election victories.

items.title: What we know about how H5N1 bird flu got here and where it may appear next
items.description: Authorities were worried about avian influenza coming in from the north, until the virus started moving across the Southern Ocean. Now infected birds have been found in Western Australia. Where else could birds carrying the virus land?

items.title: The moment Tehran's men leave JD Vance waiting in a Swiss negotiating room
items.description: In a room in a glamorous Swiss resort, the United States delegation, Pakistani and Qatari officials were awaiting the arrival of the Iranian representatives. But as Tehran's men enter the room, they appear to notice the press.

items.title: Australia secures biggest-ever defence export deal with Canada
items.description: Canada is buying a powerful radar system to monitor the Arctic, modelling the system on Australia's JORN radar.

items.title: Second Australian case of deadly bird flu confirmed
items.description: Authorities say a second bird found sick on WA's south coast had the deadly H5 strain of avian flu, as one of the nation's biggest chicken producers announces it is locking down its WA operations.

items.title: Victoria ended native forest logging. So where are these trees coming from?
items.description: Four Corners follows the logs, and the money, to uncover how efforts to end logging have shifted the timber trade across state borders.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
